transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess… I’m here because I feel like I’m always going from one thing to the next. Like I can’t really just sit idle. With the new setup at work, it’s been harder to keep that from showing.
Have there been times when you felt unusually up or energized for several days in a row?
Not really, no. I mean, I have days where I’m busy or keyed up, but I wouldn’t say several days in a row feeling unusually up like that.
Do you often have trouble sustaining your attention on tasks, even when you want to focus?

Yeah… sometimes. Like in longer coaching meetings, or if I’m reading some new procedure at work, I start out paying attention. Then a few minutes later I realize my eyes were moving over it, but I didn’t really take it in.
Looking back to when you were a child, did you already have this same kind of trouble staying focused?

Yeah… I think so. It wasn’t just with this job. Back in grade school, teachers would write things like I was bright but careless, or that I talked out of turn. I remember getting reminded to stay on my work a lot.
Do you often feel physically restless, like you need to keep moving even when the situation calls for sitting still?
Yeah, sometimes. If I’m sitting through a training video or a slow appointment, I start feeling kind of boxed in. I’ll want to stand up, stretch, or just do something with my hands.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about different parts of your life, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
Not really, no. I mean, I worry about normal stuff, I guess, but I wouldn’t say it takes up a lot of my time or comes out of nowhere.
